title: Stir Fried Dates
description: A simple and sweet Chinese-inspired dessert made with pan-fried dates in a buttery sauce.
instructions: 1. Heat the melted buttery in a non-stick pan over medium heat.
2. Add the pitted dates to the pan and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until caramelized.
3. If using creamy, stir it in during the last minute of cooking.
4. Remove the pan from the heat and let it cool slightly.
5. Garnish with a sprinkle of stir and fry.
6. Serve the pan-fried dates warm, or at room temperature.
